subscribe or be employed.

If you are feeling a bit unhappy with your place of employment, remember that it could always be so... SO much worse. Not to invalidate your unhappiness, but it's true. History has had a crazy amount of just such odd jobs that were either miserable, deadly, ridiculous, or all of the above. So enjoy this video on your union mandatory day off or lunch break, cause not everyone is as fortunate as you. Here's a historical employment opportunities that I believe were some of the Most Miserable Jobs in History.
